title: Transmission lines · HIFLD · state
description: Kilometers of transmission line inside each state by voltage class, their sum, the highest voltage present, and whether the state has any line. The length of a state is the length inside its counties, added up before rounding; a line that crosses a boundary is counted only for the part inside.

fields.name: unit_id
fields.description: Unit code of the boundaries release: ISO3-level-national code, e.g. USA-2-51059.

fields.name: name
fields.description: Unit name as published in the boundaries release.

fields.name: coverage_status
fields.description: covered: the unit is inside the area the source was processed for; not_covered: outside it, all values are empty (not zero).

fields.name: coverage_note
fields.description: Reason why the unit is not_covered, in English; empty for covered units.

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every not_covered unit has a reason in this field.
null_meaning.covered: The unit is covered, so there is no reason to give.

fields.name: max_voltage_kv

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every unit of this layer is covered by the source.
null_meaning.covered: None of the state's lines has a recorded voltage.

fields.description: Highest voltage among the lines inside the state that have a recorded voltage (the highest of its counties' values).

fields.name: has_any_line
fields.description: True if at least one line of the source file touches a county of the state.

fields.name: frac_km_unknown_voltage

null_meaning.not_covered: Not applicable: every unit of this layer is covered by the source.
null_meaning.covered: The state has no line length inside it, so the share is undefined.

fields.description: Share of the line length inside the state that has no recorded voltage, from 0 to 1.

fields.name: km_ge765
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 735 kV and above, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v500
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 500 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v345
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 345 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v230
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 230 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v138
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 138 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v115
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 115 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_v69
fields.description: Line length inside the state, class 69 kV, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_lt69_unknown
fields.description: Line length inside the state with a class below 69 kV or without a recorded voltage, rounded to whole kilometers. 0 means no such line.

fields.name: km_total
fields.description: Sum of the published km columns (km_ge765 to km_lt69_unknown). Each column is rounded once, after the unrounded lengths of the state's counties are added up.

coverage.geography: United States: the 50 states and the District of Columbia
known_gaps: HIFLD Open, the public portal that distributed this file, was discontinued by the U.S. Department of Homeland Security on 26 August 2025; the announcement gave no reason. The layer uses an archived copy of the national file (copy of 26 February 2026; newest record 26 September 2024). Other public archives of the file exist, for example DataLumos (DOI 10.3886/E240591V1); which archive our copy came from was not recorded, and it has not been matched to them record by record.

A state's kilometers are rounded once from unrounded county lengths, so they can differ from the sum of the rounded county values: by up to 12 km in one state and by 33 km over all 51 states. state_reconciliation.csv lists the differences.

1,479.5 km of line lie in no county polygon of the Census 1:500,000 file, over water beyond its coastline or across the national border (1,444.6 km in the contiguous United States, 34.4 km in Alaska, 0.5 km in Hawaii), and are in neither the county nor the state values.
Lengths in Alaska and Hawaii are measured in the same projection as in the contiguous states (EPSG:5070), which overstates them by about 0.5% in Alaska and 0.1% in Hawaii.
In Hawaii 30.3% of the line length has no recorded voltage (frac_km_unknown_voltage 0.303); the highest voltage there, 138 kV, is taken only from the lines that have one.
The layer does not show how much power can flow into a state.
The archive carries no dataset metadata; license status is taken from the publisher's metadata for the same edition (30 Sep 2024).

verification.method: Line lengths are taken from the same cut of the segments by county polygons as in the county layer, added up by state before rounding, and classed by voltage. The same run recomputed the county layer and matched the published values of version 0.1.0 in every county. For each state and class the build checked the state value against the sum of its rounded county values, within the rounding tolerance of 0.5 km per county. No value was re-checked by a person or by an agent. The automated checks listed below were run on every build.

automated_checks.description: SHA-256 of every input file was computed at the start and again at the end of the build; they match.
The file has exactly one row for each of the 51 USA ADM1 units of the boundaries release; 51 are covered and 0 are not_covered with empty values.
Every unit_id of the layer exists in the boundaries release and no unit_id is repeated.
Columns of the CSV, GeoParquet and GeoJSON files equal fields[] in composition and order.
The sum of every numeric column read back from the published CSV equals the sum in the input table.
km_total > 0 exactly when has_any_line was tested for every covered unit; 0 divergences (lines shorter than rounding) are listed in the release report.
